title: Hearty Harvest Greek Vegetable Wrap
description: A flavorful and festive Greek dish featuring roasted vegetables and wrapped in a corn husk, perfect for a satisfying lunch
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, toss the sliced eggplant, zucchini, red bell pepper, and onion with olive oil, salt, and grated ginger until they are evenly coated
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes
While the vegetables are roasting, prepare the corn husks by soaking them in water for 30 minutes
Once the vegetables are done, let them cool for a few minutes
To assemble the wraps, lay a corn husk flat and spread a tablespoon of hummus down the center
Add a few slices of the roasted vegetables on top of the hummus
Fold the bottom edge of the corn husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly
Serve the wraps warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
